title: C.L.A.R.A. — AI-Powered Articulation Therapy Assistant
bullets: Curated a 2,000+ sample audio dataset and fine-tuned a Wav2Vec2 deep learning model using transfer learning, applying ONNX optimization to improve inference performance for real-time phoneme detection.

Built and evaluated a production FastAPI service integrating Whisper, Wav2Vec2, and an LLM to generate intelligent, personalized feedback, combining model development with real-world application design.
Collaborated across model development, backend engineering, and real-time facial emotion detection using BlazeFace and Vision Transformer to deliver an end-to-end AI solution.

title: AI-Powered Facial Recognition Attendance System
bullets: Trained and evaluated face detection and recognition models (SSD, ResNet-50) on custom data, then deployed the trained models as a real-time service using Flask-SocketIO and PostgreSQL.

title: Spring PetClinic — DevOps Pipeline Implementation
bullets: Built a 6-stage GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline with automated testing and deployment, and containerized infrastructure with Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform-provisioned AWS.
